verdict.rationale: Scribe is API-first. The UI playground's inputs (record, sample, upload, URL) map to documented API modes: Live WebSocket streaming, synchronous transcribe, and batch jobs with URI inputs. Vocabulary assets also have list and delete endpoints, and the OpenAPI spec covers the full job lifecycle. However, no doc states UI/API parity, and credential setup (expiration, IP allowlist, scopes) is documented only as a UI flow, with no API equivalent shown. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, API-based credential/key management, and independent hands-on confirmation that every UI action has an API counterpart.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: In Input, make a recording, use a sample conversation, upload a file, or enter a URL for a public audio or video file.
submit and list batch jobs, get or cancel a job, list job files, retrieve an individual file, transcribe synchronously, and open the Live Scribe WebSocket
Batch jobs accept cloud URI, prefix, or manifest inputs, including pre-signed object URLs
